title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
problem_statement: FastAPI services lack standardized error handling, validation middleware, and proper HTTP status code management
risk_if_unaddressed: Service instability, poor user experience, and difficult debugging in production
suggested_approach: Implement FastAPI exception handlers, validation middleware, and standardized error response schemas
success_criteria: All endpoints return consistent error response format
Input validation implemented for all API endpoints
Proper HTTP status codes for all error conditions

provenance.evidence: FastAPI endpoints without visible error handling patterns

title: Add Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: No visible authentication or authorization mechanisms for API endpoints and agent access
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to sensitive agent capabilities and data manipulation
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for different agent capabilities
success_criteria: All API endpoints require valid authentication
Secure token management and refresh mechanisms

provenance.evidence: No authentication decorators or middleware detected

title: Implement Comprehensive Testing Suite
problem_statement: Despite having a tester agent, no visible unit tests, integration tests, or test automation
risk_if_unaddressed: Regression bugs, unstable releases, and difficult maintenance
suggested_approach: Create pytest-based test suite with unit tests for agents, integration tests for APIs, and automated test execution
success_criteria: Automated test execution in CI/CD pipeline
Integration tests for all API endpoints

provenance.evidence: Tester agent exists but no test files detected in repository

title: Secure Configuration Management
problem_statement: Critical configuration data stored in plain JSON files without encryption or validation
risk_if_unaddressed: Configuration tampering, credential exposure, and system compromise
suggested_approach: Implement encrypted configuration storage with schema validation and access controls
success_criteria: All sensitive configuration encrypted at rest
Schema validation for all configuration files

provenance.evidence: Critical configuration in unencrypted JSON files

title: Production Deployment Hardening
problem_statement: Docker configuration lacks production security hardening and scalability considerations
risk_if_unaddressed: Security vulnerabilities and poor performance in production environment
suggested_approach: Implement multi-stage Docker builds, security scanning, and production-ready compose configuration
success_criteria: Multi-stage Docker builds with minimal attack surface

provenance.evidence: Basic Docker configuration without production hardening
